hlni.insight: Degrees are defined by their 'Evaluation Focus' (individual recall vs. applied strategy) rather than just the degree title.
hlni.audienceGap: Students often assume B.Com is 'theoretical' and BBA is 'practical' without evidence.
hlni.viewerChange: Viewer shifts from picking a label to evaluating specific assessment styles.
hlni.support: This method focuses on the ratio of individual exams to group work, which is a structural reality of how different programmes are evaluated.
hlni.payoff: The viewer understands that their success depends on whether their work style aligns with the program's assessment structure.

reelTitle: B.Com vs BBA: The Assessment Method Shift
creativeAngle: Structural evaluation based on assessment style rather than degree labels
objective: Provide a practical method for comparing degrees based on personal performance metrics
targetAudience: +2 students seeking academic depth and well-supported course and career decisions

shots.name: The Hook
shots.visual: Split-screen: A student looking at a 'B.Com' brochure vs a 'BBA' brochure, looking confused.
shots.dialogue: Choosing between B.Com and BBA? Stop comparing labels.
shots.onscreenText: B.Com vs. BBA: Stop the guesswork
shots.cameraPerformance: Static medium shot with slight zoom on the student's face.

shots.name: The Method
shots.visual: A physical 'Evaluation Matrix' icon appears. Left side shows 'Individual Exam Paper', right side shows 'Team Case Study'.
shots.dialogue: Check three course outlines for each. Look at the grading ratio: individual exams versus group projects. Which output style sustains your focus?
shots.onscreenText: Method: Ratio of Exams vs. Projects
shots.cameraPerformance: Clean graphic overlay on a neutral workspace background.

shots.name: The Payoff
shots.visual: Student smiles, confident, closing a laptop.
shots.dialogue: Degrees vary by university. Pick the assessment style that matches your strengths, not the title.

productionNotes.editing: Rhythmic cuts to match the screen icons.

creativeSummary.keyCreativeIdea: Shifting the comparison from generic degree names to individual assessment preferences.
shootingPriority: Clear graphic comparison of exam types

selected.title: The Assessment Method Shift
selected.audienceGap: Belief that B.Com is 'theory' and BBA is 'practical'.
selected.hlni: Degrees aren't defined by subject names, but by the 'Evaluation Focus' (e.g., individual knowledge recall vs. group-applied strategy).
selected.viewerChange: Shifts focus from picking a degree by title to picking by preferred assessment style.
selected.concept: A split-screen comparison of how a final grade is earned in each.
selected.device: Contrast between a solitary exam paper and a collaborative project brief.
selected.support: Degrees vary by university; focusing on assessment style is a transferable way to evaluate any syllabus.
methodSteps: Find 3 course outlines for each degree.
Note the ratio of individual exams to group projects.
Compare which workload style matches your peak productivity.
selected.interpretationRule: Higher group-work density often indicates a management/applied focus.
selected.visibleProof: Side-by-side comparison of a 'Paper-based Exam' icon vs. a 'Team Case Study' icon.
selected.payoff: The viewer realizes their choice is about how they perform best, not just the label.
